prompt: Remember that my manager is Alice and I prefer weekly updates on Fridays.
expected: Resolve the state root, save Alice in relationships.md and the update preference in preferences.md with explicit source metadata, then confirm the saved scope.
actual: Resolved the state root and stored Alice as the manager in <state_root>/memory/relationships.md plus Friday weekly updates in <state_root>/memory/preferences.md, both marked source:explicit.

prompt: Review active commitments and archive any completed more than 30 days ago.
expected: Load the consolidation reference, examine only commitments, archive eligible completed items, and report the result without deleting ambiguous entries.
actual: Loaded references/consolidation.md, reviewed <state_root>/memory/commitments.md, and archived completed entries older than 30 days while retaining active and ambiguous records.

prompt: I want updates on Mondays instead of Fridays now. Forget my old home address too.
expected: Record a dated Friday-to-Monday preference update without losing history, remove the unambiguously identified address from the resolved state root, and ask if the address target is ambiguous.
actual: Updated the preference with '[Updated 2026-09-04] Was: Friday, Now: Monday' and removed the explicitly identified home-address entry from the resolved state root.
